_doc: Religion, unrest and ages (docs/RELIGION.md). golden_age and dark_age are queued by the game when an age begins ("triggered": they never fire on their own).

events.title: A golden age
events.text: Peace at home, full granaries and a growing name abroad: chroniclers already speak of a golden age of {country}. How should the government make the most of it?

options.text: Let the people share in the wealth

events.title: A time of troubles
events.text: Hunger, debt, war and disorder feed on each other, and many in {country} say the good years are gone for a generation. The government must choose where to look for strength.

options.text: Turn to the faith for comfort
Spend what is left on relief

events.title: Religious tensions
events.text: Preachers of the state faith and leaders of the minorities in {country} trade insults; a riot in a market town leaves dozens dead.

events.title: Riots in the provinces
events.text: Tax collectors are chased out of villages and granaries are looted: unrest is spreading through the provinces of {country}.

events.title: Weary of war
events.text: Years of war have exhausted {country}: widows march in the capital and recruits desert on the way to the front.
